description: This file defines the Output<T> class in the TensorFlow Java API. It provides a symbolic handle to a tensor produced by an operation, including methods to access the operation, index, shape, data type, and tensor value, as well as overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: A symbolic handle to a tensor produced by an Operation in TensorFlow Java API.

methods.name: op
methods.description: Returns the Operation that will produce the tensor referred to by this Output.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the index into the outputs of the Operation.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the (possibly partially known) shape of the tensor referred to by this Output.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the DataType of the tensor referred to by this Output.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Returns the tensor at this output, primarily in eager execution mode.

methods.name: asOutput
methods.description: Implements Operand interface, returning this Output.
